title: pvCellGridElevation
body:
## pvCellGridElevation

Adds a scalar attribute (default name Elevation) to a cell grid (vtkCellGrid) measuring distance from Origin: along Axis for Planar distance (ParaView default), from the line through Origin along Axis for Cylindrical distance, or from Origin itself for Spherical distance. Shock adds an offset that makes the field jump between cells, intended to demonstrate discontinuous Galerkin (DG) cells. Use it on cell-grid data from pvConvertToCellGrid or pvIOSSCellGridReader; for ordinary datasets use elevation or pvElevation.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Input must be a vtkCellGrid; convert unstructured grids with pvConvertToCellGrid first.
- Keep Shock at 0 for a continuous distance field; non-zero values deliberately create discontinuities at cell boundaries.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `CellGridElevation`. Identity: `filters/ComputeCellGridElevation`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: An input cell-grid. Accepted data: cell grids (discontinuous Galerkin cells) (vtkCellGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkCellGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AttributeName` | The name of the output attribute added to the mesh. | `{"type":"string"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `Axis` | A non-zero vector. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `DistanceType` | Set how distance is measured. | `{"type":"enum","values":["Planar distance","Cylindrical distance","Spherical distance"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Planar distance"` |
| `Origin` | A point in space. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `Shock` | An offset to add to the elevation. Non-zero values create discontinuities. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
